claims.text: Jack Reed (D-RI) is listed as Ranking Member of the Senate Armed Services Committee on the committee's official membership page.
Roger F. Wicker (R-MS) is listed as Chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee on the committee's official membership page.

August 2026 holders of the twelve offices: Roger F. Wicker (SASC Chairman) and Jack Reed (SASC Ranking Member); Susan Collins (SAC Chair) and Patty Murray (SAC Vice Chair); Mitch McConnell (SAC Defense Subcommittee Chair) and Christopher A. Coons (SAC Defense Subcommittee Ranking Member); Mike Rogers of Alabama (HASC Chairman) and Adam Smith (HASC Ranking Member); Tom Cole (HAC Chairman) and Rosa L. DeLauro (HAC Ranking Member); Ken Calvert (HAC Defense Subcommittee Chair) and Betty McCollum (HAC Defense Subcommittee Ranking Member).
